Dear [Hiring Manager],  

I’ve collaborated with Hugo Ramirez on a few projects at NexaCorp, mostly as a peer in our SaaS engineering team. We’ve worked closely on backend systems and occasionally cross-departmental initiatives, but our interactions are generally focused on shared technical goals.  

Hugo’s strongest attributes are his deep Python expertise and ability to architect scalable systems. He owns a critical Python service that processes user data, which he optimized to reduce latency by 40% through smarter caching and async workflows. His AWS infrastructure work is equally notable—he designed a multi-region architecture for a product launch, ensuring seamless scaling during a 3x traffic spike.  

One standout moment was when Hugo led a microservices refactor. He restructured a monolith into modular services using Go, which improved deployment speed and fault isolation. His REST API design for that system became a template for other teams, blending clarity with robust error handling. I’ve also seen him mentor junior engineers on PostgreSQL best practices, like indexing strategies and query optimization, which directly boosted database performance in several projects.  

Hugo is reliable, detail-oriented, and brings a pragmatic approach to complex problems. His work ethic is consistently high, and he’s never shied away from tackling technical debt.  

If you’d like further details, feel free to reach out.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
